gaps.explanation: seem/appear take the to-infinitive: seems to know.

gaps.sentence: Don't forget ___ off the lights when you leave.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do a duty: forget to turn.

gaps.sentence: She admitted ___ the last train and had to take a taxi.
gaps.explanation: 'Admit doing' — confess to a past action takes the gerund.

gaps.sentence: You risk ___ your licence if you drink and drive.
We expect ___ the results by Friday.
gaps.explanation: expect takes the to-infinitive: expect to receive.
deny + -ing or having + past participle: denied doing/having done. Both accepted.

gaps.sentence: I resent ___ treated as an amateur when I have twenty years’ experience.
gaps.explanation: 'Resent' takes a gerund; the passive is 'being treated'.
